title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Leaving a Firm - Client Notification
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal is leaving a large law firm to start a solo practice. Regarding the clients that the paralegal is currently working on, what is the proper procedure?
options: The paralegal automatically takes the files with them, as the clients belong to the individual practitioner.
The paralegal and the firm must notify the clients of the departure and advise the clients that they have the option to stay with the firm, go with the departing paralegal, or retain new counsel.
The files must stay with the firm; the departing paralegal cannot communicate with those clients under any circumstances.
The paralegal can secretly email the clients from a personal address encouraging them to leave the firm.
questions.explain: Rule 3.08 (Leaving a Firm). When a paralegal leaves a firm, the clients must be given the choice of who they wish to represent them. Neither the firm nor the departing paralegal "owns" the client. Communication to the client must outline their options clearly and neutrally.
